bull_bear.body:
- Financial risk arising out of operations — Named by the Directors as one of the risks identified and taken into account while formulating policies, in the MD&A 'Risks and concerns' paragraph. No quantification or mitigation detail is given.
- Increased competition in the Company's sectors / areas of operation — Explicitly listed by the Directors among the risks identified in the MD&A 'Risks and concerns' paragraph.
- Adverse business conditions in the Company's markets — Listed by the Directors among the identified risks in the MD&A 'Risks and concerns' paragraph; the Company depends on demand from nearby food-industry participants for its infrastructure and allied services.
- Revenue concentration in a single rental/cold-storage stream — Structural, readable from the Directors' own description: the main business of the Company is the revenue from Cold Storage and Lease Rental Income, so earnings depend on occupancy and lease renewal of one asset base rather than on a diversified revenue mix.
- Execution risk on the newly developed Food business — The processed food, vegetables and Makhana line is described as newly developed and contributed a turnover of Rs 129.15 Lakh in FY2025-2026; it is an unproven product vertical with no disclosed capacity, customer base or distribution.
